All unmatched DBLP records remain visible; no universal all-papers completeness claim is made.

MIT faculty start statements and UIUC original annual appointment PDFs were checked. Harvard points are source-dated observations, not inferred appointment starts.
Malte Hoffmann mixed DBLP identity: foreign Drone Air Traffic Control namesake and unsplit PID excluded; positive OpenAlex identities require multiple exact owned publication matches.
A recovered record is publication metadata with evidence, not a claim that the full-text PDF was downloaded.
